# P35.50 — Page-type registry, route discovery, script-policy and no-JS parity specs

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/328_P35.50__page-type-registry-and-route-discovery.md`
(manifest row **328**, Round 11 / P35, UXK0-1). Invoked
`live_verification=false` — committed web code, specs and doc stanzas
only. **This row performs no hosted mutation, no live legs and no
publication:** the machinery binds in CI on merge and constrains what
later rows may ship; no public page's content or script payload changes
at this row's merge. Requirement stamps: **SIG-UI-036** (as amended by
ADR-155 — the registry is the enforcement shape it names),
**SIG-UI-041** (budgets per page type, enforced in CI, unclassified
route fails the build), **SIG-UI-037** (JS-off completeness proved by
the parity spec), **SIG-UI-050** (every interactive surface keeps its
no-JS equivalent — the parity spec is that requirement's test),
**SIG-FIND-005** (the discovered-route sweep feeds it). Cited:
**ADR-155** + **D-K0-1 [A-12] = a** (the gate answer, applied not
re-decided — the machinery implements the ADR, never re-decides it),
**ADR-068** (`/curate/**` stays T3), **ADR-134** (the island budgets
this row's T2 sweep still guards), **D-J3-7** (JSON-LD linked files
only), **UXR-02** (the registry-field design ref), K0 NEW-4 / K13 §7
W1. **Base:** `r11/P35.48-agent-review-lane` (PR #347, head `749220d`,
5/5 green at dispatch). **Gate:** none.

## The problem

ADR-155 replaced the blanket zero-JS rule with page types — T0 record &
print, T1 content, T2 explore, T3 tools — but nothing enforced it: the
type of a route lived in planning documents, the script policy was a
hand-maintained list in `islands.spec.ts` ("these three pages may ship
scripts"), and every e2e/axe sweep iterated a hand list a new route
could silently miss. A page could land unclassified, carry the wrong
script posture, or lose its no-JS equivalent with no gate noticing.
This row makes every built route carry a declared type and makes CI
prove the type's rules.

## What landed

- **`web/src/lib/page-types.ts`** (new) — the single authority: K0
  §4.2's table verbatim, extended only where today's built surface has
  routes the table does not name (`/terms/`, `/data-collection/`, the
  flat `403.html`/`404.html`/`410.html` error copies) and where K0
  itself records an interim (`/network/` classifies as the T2 surface
  it currently is — its redirect/T1 migration is the GX-09a row's).
  Each entry carries the draft-UXR-02 fields: patterns, type, owner
  ticket, data-contract id (or the recorded string `none` — absence is
  recorded, never a fabricated id), the K0 §4.4 no-JS equivalent
  (kind + description + parity `testIds` on T2), `internal` for the
  `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL` surface, and `examples` the unit suite
  classifies back to their own row. Matching is **most-specific-wins**
  with leaf-first coverage vectors (`/**/print/` beats `/dossier/**`;
  `/s/*/map/` stays T2 inside the `/s/*/**` umbrella): zero matches →
  `unclassified`, a two-entry tie → `ambiguous`, both build errors —
  never first-match, never a coin flip.
- **`web/astro.config.mjs`** — `sigPageTypes()` `astro:build:done`
  hook, last in the chain so it sees the complete emitted tree
  (injected internals, flat error copies, generated pages): walks
  `dist/**/*.html`, fails the build on any unclassifiable route, and
  writes `dist/page-types.json` (`sig.page-types-manifest/1`: path,
  file, type, matched pattern, owner, contract, chrome, internal).
  `data-sig-chrome` markers added to the three layouts so the manifest
  records chrome honestly.
- **`web/tests/e2e/pages.ts`** — rewritten: every sweep list is derived
  from the manifest, never a hand list (`SHELL_PAGES` = chrome `full`,
  `CHROME_PAGES` = `minimal`, `CURATE_PAGES` = T3, `ISLAND_PAGES` = T2,
  `A11Y_PAGES` = all 49 discovered routes,
  `FRESHNESS_SORT_PAGES`/`JURISDICTION_DOSSIER_PAGES` by
  type+path). Rewired consumers: axe, shell, chrome, curate (now
  covering the dynamic `[id]` routes), corrections-methodology, budget
  (guards every discovered T2 carries a budgets row until P35.51's
  `page-budgets.json`). A missing/stale manifest fails loud with the
  build instruction.
- **`web/tests/e2e/script-policy.spec.ts`** (new, replaces the policy
  half of `islands.spec.ts`) — T0 asserts no `<script` substring at
  all; T1 admits only allow-listed `type="module"` entries
  (`t1-module-entries.json`, **empty by contract** — the mechanism is
  this row's, UXK0-4's elements register members) plus the recorded
  Astro bootstrap hashes (`astro-runtime-script-hashes.json`); T2
  requires island scripts present and admits only recorded bootstrap +
  content-hashed `/_astro/` module srcs; inline `application/ld+json`
  is a violation on every type (D-J3-7 = linked files only);
  `on*=` handlers and `javascript:` URLs banned on every discovered
  route including T3. The check lives in `script-policy-check.ts`
  and is unit-tested against planted violating fixtures
  (SIG-ENG-042 — the check is proven, never assumed).
- **`web/tests/e2e/nojs-parity.spec.ts`** (new) — T1 `main` text with
  JS off equals JS-on text minus `[data-enhancement]` subtrees (with a
  mechanism proof that an enhancement diff is the ONLY tolerated
  difference — an unmarked one is caught); each T2 route's
  registry-named equivalent `testIds` resolve with JS off; a stateful
  `sig.workspace-state/1` URL opened with JS off shows
  `no-js-state-notice` naming the static equivalents, inert under JS.
- **`web/src/components/NoJsStateNotice.astro`** (new) — the K0 §4.4
  stateful-URL notice, mounted on `/map/`, `/network/`, `/search/` with
  each surface's state params and anchor links to its named
  equivalents. `<noscript>`-wrapped (a static build cannot condition
  markup on a query string — the wording names what a URL on the page
  CAN encode, true with or without state); invisible whenever JS runs.
- **`islands.spec.ts`** — policy describes removed (superseded by
  script-policy, assertions never loosened); the interactive island
  tests (MapLibre hydrate/draw + ODbL attribution, network explorer,
  search behaviour) untouched.
- **Root `AGENTS.md` gotcha 6 + `web/AGENTS.md` gotcha 1** — rewritten
  to the landed registry; the "until P35.50/P35.51 land" hedge retired;
  the change path (new T2 surface / raised budget / runtime dep → new
  ADR) restated.
- **`CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`** entry; the registry's `"/…"`
  literals exempted in `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` via the
  designed file+token+count+reason allow-list (never a baseline raise —
  containment holds at 157).

## Discovered-route census

`SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1` build: **49 routes** — T1 29, T0 9, T3 8, T2 3
(chrome: full 31, curate 8, minimal 7, print 3); publishable build: 36.
The prior hand list swept 28 routes in the generic shells; the
discovered sweep covers all 49 — the count the staging-verified AC
requires, and the mechanism that makes a dropped route impossible.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix web run check` — green end-to-end: `astro check` clean
  (203 files), vitest 40 files / 506 tests, build (49 routes
  classified), check:licenses, Playwright 459 tests (chromium + no-js).
- `make check` — ruff/format/mypy/pytest/verify-gen green.
- Fixture-verified: a planted `src/pages/sneaky-p3550-probe.astro`
  fails the build (`page-type registry: 1 unclassifiable route(s)`);
  a planted `<script>` on a T0 fixture fails via the unit-tested
  check; the T1 enhancement-diff tolerance is mechanism-proved; T2
  notices resolve.
- `check:paths` containment holds (157 vs baseline 157).
